+ /**
+  * useGSAPTimeline Hook Stories
+  * 
+  * Demonstrates timeline management with GSAP
+  */
+ 
+ import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react'
+ import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
+ import { useGSAPTimeline } from './use-gsap-timeline'
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // Component Wrapper
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ function TimelineDemo({ config, children }: any) {
+   const containerRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null)
+   const { timeline, play, pause, restart, reverse, isActive } = useGSAPTimeline(config)
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (!timeline || !containerRef.current) return
+ 
+     const boxes = containerRef.current.querySelectorAll('.box')
+     
+     timeline
+       .to(boxes[0], { x: 200, duration: 1, ease: 'power2.out' })
+       .to(boxes[1], { y: 100, duration: 0.8, ease: 'power2.out' }, '-=0.5')
+       .to(boxes[2], { rotation: 360, duration: 1, ease: 'power2.inOut' })
+ 
+     play()
+   }, [timeline, play])
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="space-y-8"&gt;
+       &lt;div ref={containerRef} className="relative h-64 bg-gray-900 rounded-lg p-8"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="box absolute w-16 h-16 bg-blue-500 rounded" /&gt;
+         &lt;div className="box absolute left-24 w-16 h-16 bg-green-500 rounded" /&gt;
+         &lt;div className="box absolute left-48 w-16 h-16 bg-red-500 rounded" /&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;div className="flex gap-4"&gt;
+         &lt;button
+           onClick={() =&gt; play()}
+           className="px-4 py-2 bg-green-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-green-700"
+         &gt;
+           Play
+         &lt;/button&gt;
+         &lt;button
+           onClick={() =&gt; pause()}
+           className="px-4 py-2 bg-yellow-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-yellow-700"
+         &gt;
+           Pause
+         &lt;/button&gt;
+         &lt;button
+           onClick={() =&gt; restart()}
+           className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-700"
+         &gt;
+           Restart
+         &lt;/button&gt;
+         &lt;button
+           onClick={() =&gt; reverse()}
+           className="px-4 py-2 bg-purple-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-purple-700"
+         &gt;
+           Reverse
+         &lt;/button&gt;
+         &lt;div className="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-700 text-white rounded"&gt;
+           Active: {isActive() ? '✅' : '❌'}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       {children}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // Meta Configuration
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ const meta: Meta&lt;typeof TimelineDemo&gt; = {
+   title: 'Animations/Hooks/useGSAPTimeline',
+   component: TimelineDemo,
+   parameters: {
+     layout: 'centered',
+     docs: {
+       description: {
+         component: &#96;
+ \&#96;useGSAPTimeline\&#96; provides a React-friendly way to manage GSAP timelines with automatic cleanup.
+ 
+ ## Features
+ - Automatic cleanup on unmount
+ - Timeline control methods (play, pause, restart, reverse)
+ - Progress tracking
+ - Lifecycle callbacks (onComplete, onStart, onUpdate)
+ 
+ ## Usage
+ \&#96;\&#96;\&#96;tsx
+ const { timeline, play, pause } = useGSAPTimeline({
+   paused: true,
+   onComplete: () =&gt; console.log('Done!')
+ });
+ 
+ useEffect(() =&gt; {
+   if (timeline) {
+     timeline.to('.element', { x: 100 });
+     play();
+   }
+ }, [timeline, play]);
+ \&#96;\&#96;\&#96;
+         &#96;,
+       },
+     },
+   },
+   tags: ['autodocs'],
+ }
+ 
+ export default meta

+

+     },

+   parameters: {

+     },

+ }

+ export const WithCallbacks: Story = {

+   parameters: {
+     docs: {

+         story: 'Timeline with lifecycle callbacks (check console).',
+       },
+     },
+   },
+ }
+ 
+ export const SequentialAnimation: Story = {
+   render: () =&gt; {
+     const { timeline, play } = useGSAPTimeline({ paused: true })
+     const containerRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null)

+         .from(items[3], { opacity: 0, y: 20, duration: 0.5 })

+     }, [timeline, play])

+           &lt;div className="seq-item p-4 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded"&gt;Item 1&lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;div className="seq-item p-4 bg-green-500 text-white rounded"&gt;Item 2&lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;div className="seq-item p-4 bg-yellow-500 text-white rounded"&gt;Item 3&lt;/div&gt;

+         &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;button
+           onClick={() =&gt; play()}
+           className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-700"
+         &gt;
+           Replay
+         &lt;/button&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     )
+   },
+   parameters: {

+     const { timeline, play } = useGSAPTimeline({ paused: true })
+     const containerRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null)
+ 
+     useEffect(() =&gt; {

+           {Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, i) =&gt; (

+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           ))}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;button
+           onClick={() =&gt; play()}
+           className="px-4 py-2 bg-purple-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-purple-700"
+         &gt;
+           Replay
+         &lt;/button&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;

+ # Storybook Examples Guide
+ 
+ This guide shows you how to run and explore the animation library stories in Storybook.

+ ## 🚀 Running Storybook
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash

+ - Basic - Manual timeline control
+ - AutoPlay - Timeline starts automatically
+ - WithCallbacks - Lifecycle callbacks
+ - SequentialAnimation - Multiple sequential animations
+ - StaggeredAnimation - Staggered grid animation
+ 
+ **Key Features Demonstrated:**
+ - Timeline control methods (play, pause, restart, reverse)
+ - Sequential vs parallel animations
+ - Stagger effects
+ - Lifecycle callbacks
+ 
+ #### 2. **useScrambleText**
+ Location: &#96;Animations/Hooks/useScrambleText&#96;
+ 
+ **Stories:**

+ **Key Features Demonstrated:**

+ - Glitch effects
+ - Reveal original text
+ - Custom scramble characters
+ - Speed variations
+

+ - SlowStagger - Slow motion

+ - CardGrid - Multiple cards

+ 
+ **Key Features Demonstrated:**

+ - Manual trigger control

+ #### AnimatedMenu Stories

+ 
+ #### TerminalPreloader Stories
+ - Watch progress bar sync
+ - Count glitch effects
+ - Compare different durations

+ ## 🔍 Best Practices Demonstrated
+

+ - Main title completes

+ - Then triggers footer
+ 
+ ### 2. **User Control**
+ See &#96;ManualTrigger&#96; story for programmatic control:
+ - Button to trigger enter animation
+ - Button to trigger leave animation
+ - No hover required
+

+ See &#96;UFO_ResearchMenu&#96; and &#96;UAP_Database_Loading&#96;:
+ - Custom colors
+ - Themed content
+ - Consistent styling
+ 
+ ### 4. **Performance**
+ See &#96;MultipleInstances&#96; story:
+ - Multiple simultaneous animations
+ - Staggered start times
+ - Efficient rendering
+ 
+ ## 🚦 Testing in Storybook
+ 
+ ### Visual Regression Testing
+ 1. Navigate to story
+ 2. Click "Canvas" tab
+ 3. Use viewport toolbar to test responsive behavior
+ 4. Screenshot for visual comparison
+ 
+ ### Accessibility Testing
+ 1. Install Storybook a11y addon (if not installed)
+ 2. Open story
+ 3. Check "Accessibility" panel for issues
+ 
+ ### Performance Testing
+ 1. Open Chrome DevTools
+ 2. Go to Performance tab
+ 3. Record while story animates
+ 4. Analyze animation frames
+ 
+ ## 💡 Tips for Exploration
+ 
+ ### Keyboard Shortcuts
+ - &#96;/&#96; - Search stories
+ - &#96;F&#96; - Toggle fullscreen
+ - &#96;S&#96; - Show shortcuts panel
+ - &#96;A&#96; - Toggle addons panel
+ 
+ ### Compare Stories
+ 1. Open story in new tab
+ 2. Arrange windows side by side
+ 3. Compare animations simultaneously
+ 
+ ### Extract Code
+ 1. Right-click on Canvas
+ 2. "View Page Source"
+ 3. Find component implementation
+ 4. Copy to your project
+ 
+ ## 🎬 Suggested Exploration Order
+ 
+ ### For Beginners:
+ 1. Start with &#96;TextScramble/Basic&#96;
+ 2. Try &#96;useScrambleText/Interactive&#96;
+ 3. Explore &#96;TerminalPreloader/Basic&#96;
+ 4. Check out &#96;AnimatedMenu/Basic&#96;
+ 
+ ### For Advanced Users:
+ 1. Study &#96;SequentialReveal&#96; for chaining
+ 2. Examine &#96;SystemBootSequence&#96; for complex sequences
+ 3. Review &#96;CompleteExample&#96; for full integration
+ 4. Analyze &#96;ManualTrigger&#96; for programmatic control
+ 
+ ### For Theme Designers:
+ 1. &#96;CustomStyling&#96; stories
+ 2. &#96;UFO_ResearchMenu&#96;

+ 4. &#96;DarkTheme&#96;

+ ## 📱 Responsive Testing
+ 
+ Use Storybook's viewport toolbar to test:
+ - Mobile (375px)
+ - Tablet (768px)
+ - Desktop (1280px)
+ - Large Desktop (1920px)
+ 
+ ## 🐛 Debugging Tips
+ 
+ ### Animation Not Playing?
+ 1. Check browser console for errors
+ 2. Ensure GSAP plugins are loaded
+ 3. Verify refs are attached
+ 
+ ### Stutter or Lag?
+ 1. Check Chrome DevTools Performance
+ 2. Reduce glitch count in TerminalPreloader
+ 3. Increase stagger delay
+ 
+ ### Text Not Scrambling?
+ 1. Verify &#96;scramble={true}&#96; attribute
+ 2. Check scrambleChars prop
+ 3. Ensure ScrambleTextPlugin is registered
+ 
+ ## 📦 Exporting Stories
+

+ // Sequential scramble reveals

+ import { Meta } from '@storybook/blocks'
+ 
+ &lt;Meta title="Animations/Introduction" /&gt;
+ 
+ # GSAP Animation Library
+ 
+ A comprehensive, modular animation system built with GSAP, React, and TypeScript.
+ 
+ ## 🎯 Quick Start
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;tsx
+ // Import what you need
+ import { TextScramble } from '@/lib/animations'
+ import { useScrambleText } from '@/lib/animations/hooks'
+ import { TerminalPreloader } from '@/components/animations'
+ 
+ // Use it
+ &lt;TextScramble text="HELLO WORLD" duration={2000} /&gt;
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 📦 What's Included
+ 
+ ### Components
+ 
+ - **[TextScramble](/story/animations-components-textscramble--basic)** - Matrix-style text animation

+ ## 💡 Quick Examples
+ 
+ ### 1. Simple Text Scramble
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;tsx
+ import { TextScramble } from '@/lib/animations'
+ 
+ function Hero() {
+   return (
+     &lt;h1&gt;
+       &lt;TextScramble 
+         text="ULTRATERRESTRIAL"
+         duration={2000}
+         className="text-6xl font-bold text-green-400"
+       /&gt;
+     &lt;/h1&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 2. Loading Screen
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;tsx
+ import { TerminalPreloader } from '@/components/animations'
+ 
+ function App() {
+   return (
+     &lt;TerminalPreloader
+       lines={[
+         { id: '1', content: '[SYSTEM] Loading...', scramble: true, top: '50%' }
+       ]}
+       duration={5}
+       showProgress
+     &gt;
+       &lt;YourApp /&gt;
+     &lt;/TerminalPreloader&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 3. Animated Menu
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;tsx
+ import { AnimatedMenu } from '@/components/animations'
+ 
+ function Navigation() {
+   return (
+     &lt;AnimatedMenu
+       items={[
+         { id: '1', label: 'Home', href: '/' },
+         { id: '2', label: 'About', href: '/about' }
+       ]}
+       featuredImage="/bg.jpg"
+     &gt;
+       &lt;MainContent /&gt;
+     &lt;/AnimatedMenu&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 4. Hover Animation
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;tsx
+ import { useSplitTextHover } from '@/lib/animations/hooks'
+ 
+ function NavLink() {
+   const { textRef } = useSplitTextHover()
+   
+   return (
+     &lt;a ref={textRef} href="#"&gt;
+       Hover Me
+     &lt;/a&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+

+ ## 🔧 Configuration
+ 
+ ### Global GSAP Setup
+ 
+ GSAP plugins are automatically registered:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;tsx
+ // Already done in gsap-utils.ts
+ gsap.registerPlugin(ScrambleTextPlugin, SplitText)
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Animation Constants
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;tsx
+ import { ANIMATION_CONSTANTS } from '@/lib/animations/gsap-utils'
+ 
+ ANIMATION_CONSTANTS.SLIDE_EASE          // 'cubic-bezier(0.65,0.05,0.36,1)'
+ ANIMATION_CONSTANTS.SPECIAL_CHARS       // '▪'
+ ANIMATION_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_DURATION    // 0.64
+ ANIMATION_CONSTANTS.STAGGER_DELAY       // 0.075
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+

+   duration={2000}

+ ## 🚀 Performance Tips
+ 
+ 1. **Use constants** - Avoid hardcoding animation values
+ 2. **Memoize callbacks** - Use &#96;useCallback&#96; for event handlers
+ 3. **Limit simultaneous animations** - Don't animate 100+ elements at once
+ 4. **Enable hardware acceleration** - Use &#96;will-change&#96; CSS
+ 5. **Clean up timelines** - Hooks handle this automatically
+ 
+ ## 🐛 Troubleshooting
+ 
+ ### Animation Not Playing?
+ - Check if timeline is paused
+ - Verify refs are attached
+ - Ensure plugins are loaded
+ 
+ ### Text Not Scrambling?
+ - Confirm &#96;scramble={true}&#96; attribute
+ - Check &#96;scrambleChars&#96; prop
+ - Verify ScrambleTextPlugin loaded
+ 
+ ### Performance Issues?
+ - Reduce glitch count
+ - Increase stagger delay
+ - Limit concurrent animations
+

+

+ import { 
+   useGSAPTimeline, 
+   useScrambleText, 
+   useSplitTextHover 
+ } from '@/lib/animations/hooks'
+ 
+ // Utils
+ import { clipPaths, ANIMATION_CONSTANTS } from '@/lib/animations/gsap-utils'
